Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model

Record Class EvaluationScore

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.EvaluationScore
Record Components:
relevance - How well the summary reflects the source articles.
conciseness - Brevity without loss of key information.
attributionQuality - Correctness and completeness of source citations.
toneMatch - Adherence to the requested writing tone.
completeness - Coverage of all major points from the sources.
overall - Weighted average of the five dimensions.
scoringNotes - AI-generated reasoning explaining the scores.
public record EvaluationScore(double relevance, double conciseness, double attributionQuality, double toneMatch, double completeness, double overall, String scoringNotes) extends Record
Immutable domain record representing the quality scores assigned by the AI evaluator to a single newsletter section.

Each dimension is scored on a [0.0, 1.0] scale where 1.0 is best:

  • relevance — how well the summary reflects the source articles
  • conciseness — brevity without loss of key information
  • attributionQuality — correctness and completeness of source citations
  • toneMatch — adherence to the requested NewsletterTone
  • completeness — coverage of all major points from the source material

overall is a weighted average of the five dimensions, computed by the AI evaluation adapter. scoringNotes contains the evaluator's free-text reasoning explaining the scores.
